### Executive Summary & Deck Profile

**Commander:** Vadrik, Astral Archmage  
**Power Bracket:** 3  
**Estimated Win Turn:** Turn 6-7  
**Playstyle:** This deck plays a control-oriented game, using card advantage and efficient mana generation to maintain control over the game. It aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful spells and sustained pressure, making it a mid-range control deck.

### Key Card Categorization (The Engines)

1. **Goblin Electromancer**: Instant and sorcery spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.
   - **Explanation:** This card reduces the cost of instant and sorcery spells by {1}.

2. **Searing Touch**: Buyback {4} (You may pay an additional {4} as you cast this spell. If you do, put this card into your hand as it resolves.) Searing Touch deals 1 damage to any target.
   - **Explanation:** Buyback means you can pay an extra {4} to put this card back into your hand after it resolves.

3. **The Celestus**: If it's neither day nor night, it becomes day as The Celestus enters. {T}: Add one mana of any color. {3}, {T}: If it's night, it becomes day. Otherwise, it becomes night. Activate only as a sorcery. Whenever day becomes night or night becomes day, you gain 1 life. You may draw a card. If you do, discard a card.
   - **Explanation:** The Celestus can change the day/night cycle, add any color of mana, and provide card draw and life gain when the cycle changes.

4. **Coalition Relic**: {T}: Add one mana of any color. {T}: Put a charge counter on this artifact. At the beginning of your first main phase, remove all charge counters from this artifact. Add one mana of any color for each charge counter removed this way.
   - **Explanation:** This card can add mana and store charge counters to generate more mana later.

5. **Finale of Revelation**: Draw X cards. If X is 10 or more, instead shuffle your graveyard into your library, draw X cards, untap up to five lands, and you have no maximum hand size for the rest of the game. Exile Finale of Revelation.
   - **Explanation:** This card allows you to draw a large number of cards, shuffle your graveyard into your library, and untap up to five lands.

6. **Ashling, Flame Dancer**: You don't lose unspent red mana as steps and phases end. Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, discard a card, then draw a card. If this is the second time this ability has resolved this turn, Ashling deals 2 damage to each opponent and each creature they control. If it's the third time, add {R}{R}{R}{R}.
   - **Explanation:** Ashling helps you maintain red mana and provides card draw and damage output.

7. **Mana Drain**: Counter target spell. At the beginning of your next main phase, add an amount of {C} equal to that spell's mana value.
   - **Explanation:** This card counters a spell and gives you colorless mana equal to the countered spell's mana value.

8. **Vadrik, Astral Archmage**: If it's neither day nor night, it becomes day as Vadrik enters. Instant and sorcery spells you cast cost {X} less to cast, where X is Vadrik's power. Whenever day becomes night or night becomes day, put a +1/+1 counter on Vadrik.
   - **Explanation:** Vadrik reduces the cost of instant and sorcery spells based on his power and gains +1/+1 counters when the day/night cycle changes.

9. **Mizzix of the Izmagnus**: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell with mana value greater than the number of experience counters you have, you get an experience counter. Instant and sorcery spells you cast cost {1} less to cast for each experience counter you have.
   - **Explanation:** Mizzix reduces the cost of instant and sorcery spells based on the number of experience counters you have.

10. **Inner Fire**: Add {R} for each card in your hand.
    - **Explanation:** This card adds red mana based on the number of cards in your hand.

11. **Urabrask // The Great Work**: First strike Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, Urabrask deals 1 damage to target opponent. Add {R}. {R}: Exile Urabrask, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery and only if you've cast three or more instant and/or sorcery spells this turn. // (As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter.) I — This Saga deals 3 damage to target opponent and each creature they control. II — Create three Treasure tokens. III — Until end of turn, you may cast instant and sorcery spells from any graveyard. If a spell cast this way would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead. Exile this Saga, then return it to the battlefield (front face up).
    - **Explanation:** Urabrask deals damage and adds red mana. When transformed, it can deal damage, create Treasure tokens, and allow you to cast spells from the graveyard.

12. **Sol Ring**: {T}: Add {C}{C}.
    - **Explanation:** This card adds two colorless mana when tapped.

13. **Mana Leak**: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {3}.
    - **Explanation:** This card counters a spell unless the controller pays {3}.

14. **Negate**: Counter target noncreature spell.
    - **Explanation:** This card counters a noncreature spell.

### Win Conditions & Line Execution

The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of card advantage, efficient spellcasting, and sustained pressure. The key to winning is to use card draw and mana generation to fuel powerful spells and counterspells.

**Combo Loop:**
1. **Card Draw and Mana Generation:**
   - Use **The Celestus** to generate mana and draw cards.
   - Cast **Inner Fire** to add red mana based on the number of cards in your hand.
   - Use **Ashling, Flame Dancer** to draw cards and deal damage.

2. **Cost Reduction and Counterspelling:**
   - Use **Goblin Electromancer** and **Mizzix of the Izmagnus** to reduce the cost of spells.
   - Cast **Mana Drain** and **Negate** to counter opponent spells.

### Turn by Turn Gameplan

**Turn 1:**
- Play **Sol Ring** to start generating mana.
- Play **The Celestus** to start the day/night cycle and generate mana.

**Turn 2:**
- Play **Coalition Relic** to store charge counters for future mana generation.
- Cast **Inner Fire** to add red mana based on the number of cards in your hand.

**Turn 3:**
- Play **Goblin Electromancer** to reduce the cost of spells.
- Cast **Ashling, Flame Dancer** to draw cards and deal damage.

**Turn 4:**
- Use **The Celestus** to change the day/night cycle and gain life.
- Cast **Urabrask // The Great Work** to deal damage and add red mana.

**Turn 5:**
- Use **Coalition Relic** to generate mana from stored charge counters.
- Cast **Finale of Revelation** to draw a large number of cards and shuffle your graveyard into your library.

**Turn 6-7:**
- Use **Vadrik, Astral Archmage** to reduce the cost of spells and gain +1/+1 counters.
- Cast powerful spells like **Searing Touch** with Buyback to maintain control over the game.

### Sample Opening Hand

- **Sol Ring**
- **The Celestus**
- **Coalition Relic**
- **Inner Fire**
- **Goblin Electromancer**
- **Ashling, Flame Dancer**
- **Negate**

This hand provides a strong start with mana generation, card draw, and counterspelling capabilities.
